description: For a buyer choosing between 2 and 8 AI vendors. Returns weighted criteria (sum 100), a test plan on your own cases (typical, edge and red-line cases; red lines pass only with zero violations), data-route rules for the sensitivity you give, a preregistration (canonical JSON plus SHA-256 method hash) to freeze before the first vendor run, six questions to ask any advisor (us included), Aidoptio's own disclosure for this shortlist, and one fitting next step. The plan works without Aidoptio. Case numbers are an Aidoptio method default, not a scientific norm; a plan, not a measurement and not legal advice. Deterministic: same input, same hash. Vendor names are part of the hash and are not stored. monthly_volume is validated but does not change the plan.

data_sensitivity.description: low (public or internal), medium (customer data, can be pseudonymised), high-classified (health, financial or special categories, and classified) or high-unclear (high, not classified yet).

lang.description: Language of the returned text: en (English, default) or nl (Dutch).

priorities.description: Weight per dimension: high, normal (default) or low.

red_lines.description: Rules a system must never break, e.g. "Never promise a refund".

use_case.description: The process the vendors are evaluated for: service (customer service), cases (case handling), documents (document intake and back office), sales, internal (internal helpdesk) or other.

vendors.description: Names of the vendors on the shortlist. Order does not matter for the hash.

name: plan_vendor_evaluation
title: Plan an AI vendor evaluation on your own cases
